A Muslim with something to bequeath should not pass two or three nights without his will written down; Ibn Umar never spent a night without his after hearing this.
Ill in Mecca with one daughter as heir, Sa'd was allowed to bequeath a third, which is much; leaving heirs rich is better than leaving them begging.
The Prophet left no wealth and made no will about property, only by the Book of Allah; Aisha denied any will for Ali, as the Prophet died in her lap.
